written.myAnswer: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is the field of creating machines or computer systems that can perform tasks that normally require human intelligence.
AI techniques help machine-learning models learn patterns from data, improve their performance, and make predictions or decisions.

Explainable (whitebox) models have decision-making processes that are transparent and understandable. Unexplainable (blackbox) models have processes that are difficult to interpret. Decision trees, linear regression, and rule-based systems are examples of whitebox models; neural networks and deep-learning models are examples of blackbox models.
